_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: TEMPEST Control Plan
summary: The TEMPEST Control Plan documents the TEMPEST control design techniques proposed for a development program of an equipment or system, in order to minimize potential TEMPEST vulnerabilities.
use_relationship:
The TEMPEST Control Plan documents the TEMPEST control design techniques proposed for a development program of an equipment or system, in order to minimize potential TEMPEST vulnerabilities.
a. This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
b. This DID is applicable to contracts that reference:
NACSEM 5112, "NONSTOP Evaluation Techniques" (entire document),
Paragraphs 5.1.5.1, 6.1.1.6.1 and Appendix F of KAG-30A/TSEC, "Compromising Emanations Standards Cryptographic Equipment,"
or equivalent and require preparation of a TEMPEST Control Plan.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of documents cited herein, including their approval dates and the dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as stated herein. NACSEM 5112, "NONSTOP Evaluation Techniques," current edition; and KAG-30A/TSEC, "Compromising Emanations Standards Cryptographic Equipment," current edition, are available at the Director, National Security Agency, Attention: I3213, 9800 Savage Rd, Suite 6706, Fort Meade, Md 20755-6706.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The TEMPEST Control Plan may be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The TEMPEST Control Plan shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.1 (Control Plan) of NACSEM 5112, or paragraphs 5.1.5.1, 6.1.1.6.1 (Control Plan) and Appendix F (Control Plan) of KAG-30A/TSEC, or as identified in the contract. A Control Plan shall include, as a minimum, the following information:

children.title: Title Page.
children.content:
The title page shall include:
Name of the equipment or system.
Name of the organization or firm preparing the TEMPEST Control Plan.
Name of the Contracting Agency.
Contract Number.

children.title: Management Control.
children.content: This section shall include specific responsibilities, lines of authority, and control. An implementation plan for TEMPEST control, with milestones, shall be included.

children.title: Mechanical Design.
children.content: This section shall include the following:

children.title: Construction Techniques
children.content:
Housing material
Compartmentation (RED/BLACK)
Penetrations (windows, air vents, access plates)
Drawings, including an exploded view
RF Gasketing

children.title: Interface Techniques
children.content:
Signal filtering
Power filtering
Location and mounting of filters
Connectors/Junction Boxes

children.title: Other Mechanical Design Features
children.content: which may have an impact on the TEMPEST characteristic of the unit

children.title: RED/BLACK signals
children.content:
RED/BLACK signal flow description and block flow diagram
RED/BLACK power distribution description and block flow diagram
RED/BLACK Logic (type, amplitude, and transition times)
RED/BLACK Interfaces (signal amplitude, transition times, design considerations)

children.title: Other RED/BLACK Design Features
children.content:
Physical RED/BLACK circuit layout (multi-layer boards, partitioning of circuits)
Type of cables
Grounds
Clocks

children.title: Transmitter Characteristics
children.content:
Antenna bandwidth
RF output bandwidth
IF bandwidth
Baseband Bandwidth
Type of modulation
Signaling rate
RF frequency band
RF carrier power
Sideband power

children.title: List and description of circuits susceptible to RED signal coupling
